qa_pair.question: Using only read-only metadata tools, identify the tool that an agent should call first to learn safety, privacy, pagination, availability, and workflow metadata. Answer with the exact tool name.

Inspect the manifest workflows. Which always-available local diagnostic tool should an agent call for tool-surface, cookie, browser-profile, and media-dependency preflight checks? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the history tool manifest. Which history tool is marked destructive? Answer with the exact tool name.
When may an agent claim that gemini_delete_chat verified the selected remote chat is gone? Answer with the exact verification status and data flag.
Inspect the manifest workflows. Which workflow should an agent use to dry-run, review, and then delete marked test chats or scheduled actions? Answer with the workflow name.
Inspect the history tool manifest. Which privacy label is attached to the chat export tool? Answer with the exact privacy label.
Inspect the history tool manifest. Which read-only paginated tool deep-scans Gemini Web chat-history metadata sources across observed RPC filters? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the history tool manifest. Which read-only facade combines Gemini chat history list, scan, search, read, and export actions? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the manifest workflows. Which workflow is recommended for finding and exporting Gemini chat history? Answer with the workflow name.

Inspect the manifest profiles. Which GEMINI_TOOLS profile should an agent use for read-only chat history organization and export without delete, scheduled action mutation, or Gems tools? Answer with the profile name only.
Inspect the observed Web capability manifest. Which MCP model alias maps to the displayed Gemini Web model named 3.1 Pro? Answer with the alias only.
Inspect the observed Web capability manifest. Which MCP model alias maps to the displayed Gemini Web model named 3.8 Flash? Answer with the alias only.
When a generic Gemini MCP video request returns only chat text and ARTIFACT_NOT_RETURNED, which dedicated Gemini Web page has a verified video-generation mode? Answer with the URL.
Inspect the observed Web capability manifest. What is the RPC id for the tool or mode status probe observed around Canvas and Guided Learning toggles? Answer with the RPC id only.
Inspect the account tool manifest. Which paginated account tool reads active or inactive scheduled-action entries? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the account tool manifest. Which read-only account tool reads one scheduled action by id using the observed Web GetTask RPC? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the account tool manifest and capability notes. Which tool lists localized Library capability/template entries rather than private Library assets? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the account tool manifest. Which non-destructive mutation tool moves an existing Gemini Web chat into a native Gemini Web Notebook? Answer with the exact tool name.
Inspect the manifest entry for the local prompt-library tool. Which availability group must be enabled for gemini_manage_prompts? Answer with the group name only.
Inspect the manifest workflows. Which workflow should an agent use after explicit authorization to create, verify, and clean up a scheduled action? Answer with the workflow name.
Inspect gemini_reset annotations and manifest metadata. Can this client reset delete non-retained remote chats? Answer with its destructiveHint and openWorldHint boolean values.
If client reset succeeds locally but remote chat cleanup fails, which operation state must the agent preserve instead of claiming complete cleanup? Answer with the state only.
After authentication material changes, what happens to cleanup work belonging to the previous authentication context? Answer with the state and cancellation reason.
Does an HTTP 200 delete response followed by a malformed or wrong-ID read-back prove that a chat or scheduled action is absent? Answer yes or no.
Can an image returned for a video or music request satisfy that requested media operation? Answer yes or no.
When a recognizable local audio/video container cannot be checked because the media decoder is unavailable, what Artifact verification status applies? Answer with the status only.
Can changed chat text or a quota refusal alone prove that no-ID Deep Research completed a report? Answer yes or no.
Which read-only facade must the scoped notebooks manifest include when history-organize enables it? Answer with the exact tool name.
When the bounded history source cannot advance despite more remote records, what operation state and next_offset value should the agent inspect? Answer with both values.
Can a content search with failed chat reads be treated as complete evidence that no matches exist? Answer yes or no.
Inspect the media creation workflow. Can chat text or a search WebImage alone satisfy an image-generation request? Answer yes or no.
Which manifest workflow explains native media selection, local verification, source-chat recovery retention, and cleanup? Answer with the workflow name only.
Inspect the media creation workflow. Which cleanup observation states establish verified absence of the newly created source chat? Answer with the two states.
Inspect the media creation workflow. Should an unsaved remote-only result or a queued request, including one with ready local output, retain its source chat for recovery? Answer yes or no.
Inspect the media creation workflow. Does a failed generation with no observed source_chat_id prove that no chat was created or justify an automatic restart? Answer yes or no.
When an interrupted media request returns a source_chat_id, should the agent preserve and inspect that chat before deciding on another generation? Answer yes or no.
Which installed MCP entrypoint exposes the seven focused multimodal creation tools? Answer with the console command only.

After focused music or video generation returns an operation_id, which tool recovers its verified artifacts after a server restart without starting another generation? Answer with the exact tool name.

Focused creation status/result and Research recovery can save files and apply stored source-chat deletion policy. What readOnlyHint and destructiveHint values describe these recovery-capable tools? Answer with both boolean values.
Does a focused music/video operation preserve its requested filename across a server restart, while keeping the existing collision-avoidance behavior? Answer yes or no.

Which optional opaque argument should a focused music/video caller reuse after losing a start response, so the registered operation is returned instead of generating again? Answer with the argument name.
How long are restart-safe operation identifiers and artifact locators retained in private metadata, excluding renewable pending cleanup authority? Answer with the duration.
When an explicit account mutation is accepted but its requested state has no verified read-back proof, what operation state should the account facade return? Answer with the state only.
Which focused account facade lists, retries or requests cancellation of only registered cleanup jobs without scanning unrelated account history? Answer with the exact tool name.
Which primary tool renames or pins one exact Gemini chat while preserving omitted fields and requiring independent metadata read-back? Answer with the exact tool name.
What three current English thinking_level values correspond to the webpage's low, medium and high thinking choices? Answer with the values in that order.
Which read-only history action queries an existing native Task by chat_id after reconnect without submitting its prompt again? Answer with the action only.
Does the end of a native Task response stream alone prove the Task is terminal or authorize deletion of an unfinished source? Answer yes or no.
Which scheduled list/get backend reads the current native Task schedules while keeping their IDs separate from legacy daily-action mutations? Answer with the backend value.
Does an HTTP 200 account probe with no matching RPC response body establish a successful inventory read or feature reachability? Answer yes or no.
Does an observed Deep Research report-action UI menu prove that a native creation mutation RPC has been captured? Answer yes or no.
Do Gems or the local Prompt library administer native Skills from the current customize/skills page? Answer yes or no.
Which typed account facade exposes native Skills, public sharing, private Library assets and Canvas through action-specific nested requests? Answer with the tool name.
Which nested native Skills action imports a complete ZIP from file_path, optionally replacing one exact skill_id, without executing bundle files locally? Answer with the action.
Which six nested Canvas actions does gemini_account expose? Answer in the order get, versions, chat lookup, creation, editing, export.
qa_pair.answer: get, versions, chat_artifacts, create, edit, export

qa_pair.question: When the Canvas edit action receives artifact_id and text for a supported plain document, what content does it replace? Answer with the replacement scope.
Does an acknowledged Canvas update establish completion before an independent exact-artifact read-back matches all four native content slots? Answer yes or no.

The typed account facade can replace Canvas content, revoke links, delete assets and export local files. What readOnlyHint and destructiveHint values must that mixed-action facade retain? Answer with both values.
Which three nested library_assets actions read assets or remove supported media? Canvas/document removal is unavailable. Answer with the actions in list, exact read, removal order.
What provider method does the compatibility probe named library.index actually call, without establishing private Library asset coverage? Answer with the method name.
What provider method does the compatibility probe named library.assets actually call, without establishing private Library asset coverage? Answer with the method name.
Which exact resource field does the sharing delete action require to revoke one selected public link? Answer with the field name.
For gemini_understand kind=notebook, which product supplies the exact caller-selected resource_id, distinct from Gemini Web bot-based Notebooks? Answer with the product name.
How many combined local-file and native Drive, Photos or NotebookLM attachments may one understanding generation request include? Answer with the maximum number.
Does accepting an explicit native attachment resource_id open an account picker, grant missing permissions, or translate a Gemini Web Notebook ID into a NotebookLM ID? Answer yes or no.
